properties.name: studio.markdown.enabled
properties.description: Enable attachment-based Markdown extraction and knowledge pipeline APIs.

properties.name: studio.markdown.max-source-bytes
properties.description: Maximum source or converted Markdown attachment size loaded by the orchestrator. Numeric values are treated as bytes; shorthand values such as 64M and 64MB are supported.

properties.name: studio.markdown.pandoc-version
properties.description: Pandoc extractor version included in revision deduplication.

properties.name: studio.markdown.pandoc-formats
properties.description: Source formats routed through the asynchronous Pandoc document conversion path.

properties.name: studio.markdown.fallback-to-native-on-pandoc-failure
properties.description: Fall back to native Markdown extraction when Pandoc submission or conversion fails.

properties.name: studio.markdown.result-cache-dir
properties.description: Local filesystem directory used to cache generated Markdown result files by content hash before view or download streaming.

properties.name: studio.markdown.textract-version
properties.description: Native textract version included in revision deduplication.

properties.name: studio.markdown.web.base-path
properties.description: Base path for Markdown document APIs.
